notes.content:

[/p][p]Additionally, if you feel that your mouse input seems delayed, we recommend checking your [b]VSync[/b] settings. [b]VSync[/b] is designed to reduce screen tearing, but it can introduce noticeable input lag depending on your setup.[/p][p][/p][p]As for performance issues: we've taken steps to improve overall game performance in this patch. If you're still experiencing difficulties, we strongly recommend switching to [b]Performance Mode[/b] for a smoother experience.

notes.title: ⚜️Sword&Shield Simulator devlog #15⚜️Rework of Forge
notes.content:
[h2]⚜️In this post, we’ll recollect what we had, show you what we have, and present what we aim to deliver to you!⚜️[/h2]

At the very beginning, we approached the Forge as something easy to pick up — and we achieved that.
As development continues, systems are refined and mechanics improved — the Forge evolves alongside them. Our team strives to deliver the best possible experience through both our internal processes and [b]your feedback[/b]! 🔥

[h2]What have we improved?[/h2]

[h3]🛞Grinding Wheel🛞[/h3]

The mechanics of the grinding wheel were simple to understand and master. The grinding wheel was straightforward yet satisfying. Player had to move the blade along the spinning grinding wheel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/85c18b6bb4e12574aa4d2b3eb6b9a471c75cba98.png[/img]

Upon [b]your feedback[/b], we have decided to expand on it. We felt the UI drew too much focus, and the mechanics lacked depth, so we improved it! Currently, to grind the sword, the player must maintain proper RPM of the wheel while pushing the blade against it. We also moved progress from the UI and put it onto the blade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/5525678cb92182e1a063c6a355a4c4ccaae78d13.png[/img]

We love the changes we have made, and we value the [b]feedback[/b] that has pushed us to make them! Additionally, we made it possible to make mistakes now and damage the blade. Right now, the player faces a [b]greater challenge⚔️[/b] and doesn't have to take their eyes off the blade!

Our constant struggle to improve what we are going to deliver to you doesn't end here!⚔️

[h3]🔨Avnil🔨[/h3] 

Previously, forging was based on striking the target in rhythm with a bar that represented strength. Aim, time it, and strike. Looking back at that iteration, we realized it wasn’t complex enough. Moreover, the player's attention was drawn away from the forged item and onto the bar itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/211bced34f401588c9af4b8e7db2553ed1af16f8.png[/img]

We concluded that similar issues occurred within the anvil, so what have we done about it? We transformed the rhythm — the bar has been replaced with a hammer tapping the anvil. We replaced the previous UI target with cracks on the blade, and last but not least, we connected accuracy and rhythm with the rate of progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/aa644f56177cf44bda2d9c528481eb61625c8215.png[/img]

[h3]🔥Melting steel🔥[/h3]

Our previous iteration of melting was super simple: hold the metal over the pot and melt it! As you may already guess, it was too simple!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/1df4f73286233a3f5abec390f0e281aaeaf1df57.png[/img]

Now, to melt the steel, the player shall drop the metal into the pot, pump the air to raise the temperature🌡️, and keep it in range as displayed by the metal rod.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/7d287d158747a8e84c89b298ba39e35f6dbf4897.png[/img]

[h3]Sword Designer [/h3]

Last iteration of sword designer just served it's purpose, it didn't bring any joy. UI was plain and simple, Animation were a little bit jittery. We wanted to make it better so we did! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/0763900bcebcb19a7ecf3c3cb523bcd9f77b6f72.png[/img]

We improved UI, added icons, improved naming conventions, polished animations added descriptions and many more!
Just take a look!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/60868b77b62016d3c6a2dced5a399a2095c673a5.png[/img]

[h2]What have we added and our plans for the future![/h2]

[h3]What have we managed to add?🥳[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Improved cart mechanics[/b] – now it's easier to load and drive the cart🛞
[*] [b]Chisel[/b] – Swords brought from the battlefield can be dismantled for their precious components⚔️
[*] [b]Smelter[/b] – Blades from dismantled swords and armor pieces can be smelted for metal used later in the forge🔥
[*] [b]Shop[/b] – Now you may purchase and sell swords and their parts in John's shop💰
[*] [b]UI[/b] – We have overhauled the entire UI📖
[/list]
[h3]
🛠️More details about Chisel & Smelter🛠️[/h3]

[b]Chisel[/b] allows you to dismantle the sword by finding clutch points and striking them. Dismantling swords gives you four separate parts of the sword: Blade, Guard, Handle, and Pommel. These parts can be sold or reused in your next crafts!
How will you use the chisel? Slide it along the sword, find a weak point, lock it, and strike it until all 4 parts are separated!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/06c3481e517639dd1ccd5c20e9b609eb04849234.png[/img]

[b]Smelter[/b] will help you get more steel! How? Just fill it with blades, chestplates, or helmets and fire this baby up! 🔥 It will burn through your loot in no time and give you some fresh, smoking-hot steel that you can later use to forge even more swords!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/03c9904f04d724859d225805a0d19817c16d3f34.png[/img]

[h3]🌠Plans for the future of development!🌠[/h3]

So, what are our plans for the Forge? We're aiming for a [b]smoother smithing process[/b]. We plan to merge the anvil, casting, and smelting into a unified system, removing the need to switch between stations. Our future updates also include a [b]system to determine the quality of your forged sword[/b] — assessing sharpness, steel quality, balance, and more! Finally, we’re reworking the Sword Designer to improve readability, offer previews of parts, and help you assemble your masterpiece.

We hope the changes we've made — and those to come — will meet your expectations.
Stay tuned! 🔥

[h3]Best regards,
The S&S Simulator Team[/h3]

we would like to show you more technical devlog from ⚜️Sword&Shield Simulator⚜️[/h3]


In one of the quests you will have to help a stranger [b]repair his cart🪛[/b]. Returning from the battlefield🗻, he damaged his wagon wheel🛞, and you, as an experienced blacksmith, will be able to repair it. 

In the game we try to [b]reflect realism[/b], so the wheels of the carts 🛒 will be able to [b]worn out[/b] or [b]destroyed[/b] if they are subjected to extra stress, you run them over a rock or a hole. Such obstacles in [b]medieval roads[/b] were really quite a lot, so be careful

Remember, we are adding [b]customization[/b] and [b]enhancements↗️[/b] to the cart that will affect its speed or durability🔥!!!

notes.title: ⚜️Welcome to the Sword&Shield Simulator devlog #8 ⚜️
notes.content:
[h1]Danburg city of kingdom[/h1]

Dear players, we have decided to expand the gameplay with, among other things, a dialogue system that will make it much easier for you to learn the stories of the 🏰kingdom which is call
.... [b]Danburg[/b]⚜️ 

You'll learn more about Danburg and [b]the rest of the cities[/b]🏰 later, but a little more about the troubles of their citiznes now. 

[h3]Talk to people and discover stories of the kingdom[/h3]

You will be able to talk to everybody: 
[list]
[*]merchants ⚖️
[*]peasants 👨‍🌾
[*]guards 💂
[*]and even... a drunkard at the tavern! 🥂 
[/list]
You will [b]learn [/b]who they are, and some will gradually unveil the [b]game’s lore[/b] and tell you what troubles the realm. 
Some people you meet along your journey will even have [b]quests for you❔[/b]! Completing them may not only give you profit, but also valuable information📨 to [b]discover[/b] the truth about the main character’s missing father and his ultimate [b]fate[/b].
Let`s see what they say 💥
[previewyoutube=YBEViA9IYX4;full][/previewyoutube]

b]Curiosity:[/b]
The Middle Ages is a very inspiring period in the history of mankind. Of course, this is reflected in speech and dialogues. We present you with some interesting quotes from this period 

Our list of inspiring and amusing quotes from the Middle Ages.

“A tale is but half told when only one person tells it.” ~ from The Saga of Grettir the Strong, written in Iceland

“When the words come, they are merely empty shells without the music. They live as they are sung, for the words are the body and the music the spirit.” ~ Hildegard von Bingen, a 12th-century German abbess

“For even he who is most greedy for knowledge can achieve no greater perfection than to be thoroughly aware of his own ignorance in his particular field. The more be known, the more aware he will be of his ignorance.” ~ Nicholas of Cusa, a 15th-century German theologian

“Don’t depend too much on anyone in this world because even your own shadow leaves you when you are in darkness.” ~ Taqî ad-Dîn Aḥmad ibn Taymiyyah, a 14th-century theologian from Syria

You can find more at the site from which we borrowed the above https://www.medievalists.net/2023/05/25-great-medieval-quotes/

notes.title: ⚜️Welcome to the Sword&Shield Simulator devlog #7⚜️
notes.content:
[b][h1]New locations[/h1][/b]
Dear players, we decided to reveal to you that in the game ⚔️ will be a little [b]more locations[/b]  than you expected and we initially planned 😎

[b]Medieval life[/b] took place not only in the kingdom town🏰 and its surroundings, but also in remote [b]villages[/b]🏞️. So in this devlog we will show you, a [b]a mill🪚,  a sawmill and farmhouse🐖🐄,[/b]. That is, places that the player will be able/must visit and perform additional missions. What kind of...? You will find out by [b]playing the game[/b].


[h3]Farmhouse[/h3] toto a farm and livestock farm🐮🐷. 
The player will be able to reach it by traversing the remote corners of the kingdom🏰
The farmhouse was almost the entire world of a peasant and his family, consisting of a hut, outbuildings for animals and for storing crops harvested🤠 from the field.
The main crops grown there were rye, barley, millet, wheat and oats🌾.  Pigs🐖, sheep🐑, cows🐄, goats🐐, geese and chickens 🐔 were raised there. Animal🐾 meat was [b]expensive[/b] and went to the tables of the richest. Animal skin was used to make shoes and belts, as well as being used as [b]parts of armor [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/dcf95ef82b9cdfd4915ce786975fb60d8e8b52fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/2769012659ecff93ab5e9c1600232fd69ae1f17a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/f825c06203242b75282f4fdb4fc873b7279aaa7a.png[/img]

[h3]The sawmill[/h3] with Forge played a very important role, in the manufacture of [b]weapons[/b]. It made all wooden parts and was located in the forest🌳. 
It is interesting to note that the sawmill was revolutionized in 1594, when Dutch 🇳🇱 farmer[b] Cornelis Corneliszoon 🤠[/b] came up with the idea to construct a type of crankshaft. It was a simple arm and piston driven by a windmill. The device made upward and downward movements, the man was left only to move the cut trunk. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/b51806b1808d1ad18f5c686b484a3915921fd64f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/bcbb36ed82f214bdd981ddd71a8ea8860dfbf691.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/6f6ec7cffbd7483ff8566913f62b0a70f4bbbee9.png[/img]

[h3]Water mill [/h3]a structure with a device for [b]milling grain 🌾[/b] into flour and groats, moved by a water wheel or water turbine💧, located on rivers🐟. 
In the Middle Ages, water mills were the [b]most powerful[/b] machines available, when the world knew only two sources of mechanical energy other than muscle power💪: [b]water and wind[/b]. The most important, however, was water.
It was a reason that in the Middle Ages, they were sauced in processes that would have required enormous and expensive💰 manual labor. One water mill replaced the labor of about [b]a hundred people🤠[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/7212c1e5a2ba523941955ab237537182900beb83.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/f5348537bcf920331a68f2908e1cb9a22b2750eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551701/6765c925f1d135fb08714ea1ece5ff9904e926a0.png[/img]

notes.title: ⚜️Welcome to the Sword&Shield Simulator devlog #3 ⚜️
notes.content:
Welcome to the third devlog of
[h1][b]⚔️Sword & Shield Simulator⚔️[/b][/h1]

We want to show you an important tools which is a [b]wheeled cart[/b] used by our hero to transport prey from the battlefield. The first cart will be small and difficult to drive, thanks to the gold earned, it will be possible to [b]upgrade[/b] and [b]customization[/b]. As the game progresses, the number of upgrades and customizations will increase. The cart will be used to transport such things as armor, swords, anything of value that will fit on it, as well as the necessary materials for the forge. 

However, the development of the forge and the business as a whole will require a change of the wheel cart, in subsequent stages of the game the player will be able to acquire a [b]new, larger wheel cart[/b] so that he can also acquire larger pieces of equipment for the army, such as launchers, siege machines and much more


[previewyoutube=tkZsw5rhT_g;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[b]CURISITY:[/b] Archaeological findings indicate that as early as the Stone Age, people created and used various inventions to facilitate the transport and carriage of heavy objects. In about 6000 BC, it was common practice to roll a transported object on wooden shafts in a spear.
